items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: That's a Pete Rayfield... I used to like him.

ctx.x: Remember who the other clarinets are?

That's a Jewmaker. Oh yeah. That boy's a good drummer. That's a Pete Rayfield, he got one leg on. Oh yeah, you mentioned. Yeah. Oh, I can handle them over too. He'd lift, he'd play bass drum, you know? He'd do all the fella. He'd do all the fella. That's a good drummer. That's a Pete Rayfield, he got one leg on. He'd do all the fella. I used to like him. That was the Jefferson Racetrack that was taken.
Is Pritchard down here too? That's Pritchard. That's Pritchard there.
